title: What is the practical difference between Minor GC, Major GC, and Full GC, and why does G1 not really have a "Major GC"?
shortTitle: What is the difference between Minor, Major, and Full GC?

s1_definition.oneliner: Minor GC: Young Gen only (fast). Major GC: Old Gen only (ambiguous term). Full GC: entire heap + Metaspace (slowest, longest pause).
s1_definition.profdef:
- Minor GC: Young Gen only, fast, frequent
- Major GC: Old Gen only (term is ambiguous in some GCs)
- Full GC: entire heap + Metaspace, slowest
- G1: mixed collections blur the Minor/Major distinction

sections.s6_takeaway:
